# Educa Institute of Consultancy (एजुका इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ कंसल्टेंसी) — Official Knowledge Base

> India's premier professional and academic consultancy institute in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, founded by Lead Academician S. R. Anand and Co-Founder A.D. Rao. Specializing in professional certifications in Naturopathy & Ayurveda (WCNA), Wealth Consultancy in Finance Management (WCFM), Class 9-12 Board & Foundation Coaching, Computer Applications (DCA), and Career Guidance.

## Key Facts
- **Full Name**: Educa Institute of Consultancy
- **Hindi Name**: एजुका इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ कंसल्टेंसी • प्रयागराज
- **Short Name**: EDUCA
- **Founder & Managing Director**: S. R. Anand
- **Co-Founder & Managing Director**: A.D. Rao
- **Headquarters**: Vihar Gali No. 3, Utthan Road, Jhalwa, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh 211012, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: 25.4299° N, 81.7712° E
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 9369087032
- **Official Website**: https://educainstitute.vercel.app
- **Official PWA & Mobile App**: https://educainstitute.vercel.app
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 stars (Verified student & practitioner reviews)

## Academic & Professional Certification Programs
- **WCNA (Wellness & Naturopathy Consultancy Certification)**: Pulse diagnosis, panchakarma therapy, dietetics, clinical herbal consultancy, and holistic health management under S. R. Anand.
- **WCFM (Wealth Consultancy in Finance Management)**: Corporate valuation, investment portfolio design, tax advisory, and private wealth consulting under A.D. Rao.
- **Academic Foundation (Class 9th & 10th)**: Mathematics, Science, and English board exam excellence with chapter-wise DPPs and mock assessments.
- **Senior Secondary (Class 11th & 12th)**: Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics) and Commerce (Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies).
- **Computer Applications (DCA / ADCA)**: Govt recognized computer diploma with practical training.
- **Professional Communication & Public Speaking**: Leadership presentation, corporate communication, and personality grooming.

## Admissions & Online Enrollment
Online admissions are available 24/7 at https://educainstitute.vercel.app. Students can register, access free chapter handbooks, watch video lectures, and enroll in certified batches with secure online payments and instant onboarding to batch communities.
